title: Small
text: Small. Works well but the container is small. Makes fitting it in the fridge nice but have to refill often. So far so good on the filter though.

product_metadata.title: Small Water Filter Pitcher DP01, Membrane Solutions 5 Cup Mini Size Jug Fast Filter and Pour for Fridge NSF Certified, Blue
features: FAST FILTER & POUR: Quickly fill up the entire water purifier pitcher and immediately pour a great-tasting glass of filtered water ,no need waiting and no activated carbon particles.

5 CUP SMALL WATER FILTER PITCHER: Slim designed for the smaller fridge, great for road trips, motels, RV’s and camping, space-saving design ;Height 10.4", Width 2.8", Length/Depth 7.1", Weight 1 pounds.

CLEANER AND GREAT TASTING: The BPA free Membrane Solutions filter remove chlorine (taste and odor) and reduce Lead, fluoride, copper, mercury, zinc and cadmium impurities found in tap water for cleaner great tasting water.
HIGH QUALITY: Made of food-grade, BPA-free plastic; meets the food safety and human health requirement, health is ensured
Environmentally friendly, each filter can replace 300 standard 16.9 oz water bottles, environmental friendly reduce your plastic waste
